english_draft: Broadcom published its first quarter fiscal 2026 results on March 4, 2026. The quarter ended February 1, 2026. Total revenue was USD 19.311 billion. This was up 29% year over year. AI semiconductor revenue was USD 8.4 billion. This was up 106% year over year. This is the CEO's stated AI measure. Adjusted EBITDA was USD 13.128 billion. This was 68% of revenue. GAAP diluted EPS was USD 1.50. Non-GAAP diluted EPS was USD 2.05. Operating cash flow was USD 8.260 billion. Capital expenditure was USD 0.250 billion. Free cash flow was USD 8.010 billion. For the next quarter, the company forecasts total revenue of approximately USD 22.0 billion. It forecasts AI semiconductor revenue of USD 10.7 billion. These are company forecasts, not actual results. No same-period preview existed. A later historical reconstruction is not a real preview. Therefore, we cannot compare this release with prior expectations.
